verdict.rationale: AngelList documents an employee and stakeholder dashboard that shows all holdings across companies, lets employees track vesting schedules and option values, and lets them accept grants by e-signature. That covers the portal, grants and vesting-progress parts of the story. Strike price is not explicitly shown in the evidence, and nothing documents modeling equity value under different exit outcomes. Help-center notes about helping customers move to other cap table providers also cast doubt on the product's continuity. Missing for 10: explicit strike price display, scenario or exit-outcome value modeling, independent or hands-on corroboration of the employee portal.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes

citations.quote: Employees can track vesting schedules, option values, and more on their dashboard.
All holdings (convertible notes, shares, transfers, etc) from all of a stakeholder's companies that are on AngelList are available in the dashboard.
Once logged in, you can accept and acknowledge receipt of the instrument through an e-signature.
